_doc: post-interim 확정 v1.0. docs/70 §1. 선행 동결 파일 전부 무수정.

preconditions.known_disclosure: signs of four contrasts only; no magnitudes

holm6_rf_tuned.baseline_features: Morgan fingerprint only, radius 3, 2048 bits, no target-derived block
holm6_rf_tuned.hyperparameters_source: verbatim from the pre-confirmatory fair-tuning result (v1_RF/results_fairtune)

hyperparameters_provenance.not_copied_here: the selection metric value stored in the same file is a performance figure and is deliberately not reproduced in this freeze record; read it from the source file if needed

holm6_rf_tuned.rule: Take the configuration that the pre-confirmatory fair-tuning procedure had already selected, verbatim. No re-tuning.
holm6_rf_tuned.rejected_alternative: keeping the frozen r=2 block and applying only the tuned hyperparameters - that configuration has never existed and would be assembled now, carrying MORE researcher degrees of freedom
holm6_rf_tuned.supporting_evidence: ladder_freeze.json rf_hyperparameters.note states the fair-tuned RF is NOT used by the ladder, i.e. tuned RF was always a separate baseline
holm6_rf_tuned.character: benchmark comparison against a strong structure-only baseline, NOT an ablation isolating radius or hyperparameters
holm6_rf_tuned.timing: the tuned configuration was selected on the development split's validation set before the confirmatory splits existed

holm7_late_fusion.p_rf: M0 (Morgan-only RF), reusing the existing confirmatory OOF
holm7_late_fusion.p_rf_rule: registration section 14 states 'RF+seq > RF implies sequence carries information non-redundant with the FINGERPRINT'
holm7_late_fusion.p_seq_learner: the frozen confirmatory RF harness with identical hyperparameters, applied to the sequence block only
holm7_late_fusion.p_seq_learner_rule: RQ7 is registered as RF complementarity and the baseline is RF, so holding the learner fixed and changing only the features is exactly what the contrast claims to measure; this introduces no new learner and no new hyperparameter
holm7_late_fusion.p_seq_rejected: ridge / MLP / neural learners - each would require selecting new hyperparameters after the signs became known
holm7_late_fusion.sensitivity_firewall: the sensitivity variant may not be used for the Holm 7 adjudication nor substituted for the primary
holm7_late_fusion.zero_vector_caveat: the 245 drugs without mapped targets become all-zero vectors; this zero is not an explicit missingness indicator

lambda.inner_split: SHARED with gin_inner_valid_freeze.json - same 1/9 scaffold-group split, same inner_seed = 1000*split_seed + fold_index
lambda.selection_metric: macro AP on the inner validation set, using the frozen undefined-AP exclusion rule
lambda.scope: one lambda per outer unit (split_seed, fold_index)
lambda.tie_break: smallest |lambda - 0.5|; if still tied, the smaller lambda
lambda.refit: after selecting lambda, BOTH base learners are refitted on the FULL outer-train fold
lambda.refit_rationale: without the refit, p_RF would be trained on a smaller sample than the M0 baseline it is contrasted against, so the contrast would mix training-set size with the sequence contribution
lambda.refit_assert: the refitted p_RF predictions must be byte-identical to the existing sealed M0 OOF for the same fold (deterministic RF, same training rows, same hyperparameters)
lambda.lambda_half: the lambda = 0.5 variant is always reported alongside and is never substituted by the selected lambda
lambda.rejected_alternative: inner 5-fold CV - more stable lambda but adds another split rule and another feature-fitting population

axes_a3_a4_a6.reporting_form: pre-fixed bins, identical in form to the two similarity axes already completed and sealed
axes_a3_a4_a6.reporting_form_rule: the first two continuous axes were reported as pre-fixed strata and are already sealed; using a different form for the third axis would make the axes non-comparable
axes_a3_a4_a6.no_target_handling: drugs with zero mapped targets (n = 245) form a pre-defined EXCLUDED set named no_target; they are never merged into the {0} bin and their count is reported

A3.definition: unseen target count / total target count

A4.name: pChEMBL-score-weighted proportion
A4.definition: affinity-weighted unseen proportion; pairs with missing pChEMBL are excluded from BOTH numerator and denominator; per-drug missing counts are recorded; drugs with no pChEMBL at all form a no_evidence stratum
A4.aggregation: pchembl_median as produced by the existing frozen pipeline

A6.definition: 1 if the dominant target (largest pchembl_median; ties broken by smallest UniProt accession in lexicographic order) is unseen

coverage_denominators.drug_level: 16 of 847 mapped drugs have no pChEMBL at all

axes_a3_a4_a6.resampling: reuse the seeds, B, unit and CI method already fixed by the earlier stratification blocks; no new seed is drawn
axes_a3_a4_a6.contrasts: both Delta(M2b - M1b) and Delta(M2b - P-ID) on each axis, as registered
axes_a3_a4_a6.A5_status: NOT frozen here - requires a one-off re-query and therefore advisor approval (docs/70 section 2-1). If not approved, A5 is reported as not estimable; no proxy substitution.

early_stopping_addendum.target: supplements gin_inner_valid_freeze.json (that file is NOT modified)
early_stopping_addendum.min_delta_source: the checkpoint update uses a strict greater-than comparison, so any improvement however small counts and ties do not update
early_stopping_addendum.tie_break: earliest epoch wins (automatic consequence of the strict inequality)
early_stopping_addendum.undefined_metric_rule: if the validation macro AP is undefined for an epoch (no eligible PT has an in-sample positive), that epoch is treated as NO improvement; if it is undefined for every epoch the run is recorded as a hard technical failure and retried once with the same seed and configuration, and is never silently skipped
early_stopping_addendum.observed_feasibility: each of the 15 inner validation sets has 293 to 323 PTs with positives, so the undefined case does not arise in practice

terminology_corrections.now: benchmark comparison against a strong structure-only baseline
terminology_corrections.why: radius and hyperparameters differ jointly, so no single factor is isolated
names the weight for what it is

repository_policy.already_public: recorded as-is; no deletion, no history rewrite
repository_policy.freeze_files: kept local only until a push can be made without exposing any new sign
repository_policy.rule: publication only within a scope that carries no new sign

pre_unblinding_procedures_specified.sealing_completeness_audit: before unblinding, mechanically verify that every expected artifact exists and none was opened: expected file list, hashes, model x fold x seed manifest cross-check, failure and restart log. TO BE IMPLEMENTED in a later block; specified here.
pre_unblinding_procedures_specified.sign_disclosure_matrix: a single table linking, for each contrast whose sign is known: who learned it, when, by what route, and which decisions were taken afterwards. TO BE IMPLEMENTED in a later block; specified here.
pre_unblinding_procedures_specified.unblinding_approver: to be recorded once the advisor confirms (docs/70 section 2-2)

rq_int_interpretation_narrowing: to be confirmed together with the SAP 1.2 re-freeze approval; draft wording is held in docs/69 section 7

recording_note.why_dates_differ: docs/71 was executed on the calendar day after the derivation; the verbatim Korean paragraph (1) states 2026-08-05, which is the date the definitions were derived. The recording timestamp is reported as measured and was not back-dated.
recording_note.no_authorisation: this file authorises nothing: neither GIN training nor the Holm 6 / Holm 7 computations nor the A5 re-query
